items.claim: David goes out against Goliath with his staff, a sling and five smooth stones, strikes him with one stone, and then kills him with the Philistine’s own sword.
items.ruling: The Qur’an confirms that Dawud killed Jalut (2:251). The sling, the stones and the sword are not mentioned in the Qur’an or in the hadith we checked, so we neither believe nor disbelieve them.
items.basis: Qur’an 2:251; the Bible text (1 Samuel 17:38-51, NRSVUE) read on BibleGateway

items.claim: A long story told to explain what the two adversaries were and what Dawud’s trial was.
items.ruling: Held back. Ibn Kathir (abridged) says the story usually told here is mostly based on Isra’iliyyat, that there is no report from the Prophet ﷺ that we could accept as true, and that it is better to speak briefly and refer the knowledge to Allah. We tell nothing beyond the verses.
items.basis: Tafsir Ibn Kathir (abridged English edition, read on Quran.com), on 38:21-25
